data.name: Island on cloud
data.detailed_description:
A game with a quirky art style, resembling animated children’s doodles.

The expedition team has discovered a floating isle and confirmed it as unclaimed territory, so they set out to develop it.

As a combatant assigned to the expedition, you must safeguard the team and eliminate all threats on the Sky Island.

Defeat monsters and gather resources to strengthen your equipment and powers until you conquer the isle.

————

In this game, you will travel through various stages and battle diverse monsters, claiming weapons and accessories from them. Weapons and accessories come with different tags based on their rarity, granting you bonuses in combat.

However, accessories are only effective for a single battle and will be lost once you exit combat. This mechanic ensures a unique experience every time you take on a stage.

Weapons obtained from battles can be modified at the outpost. By rerolling a weapon’s tags, you can tailor its functions to suit your playstyle.

Your goal as a player is to clear all stages and craft your favorite weapons.
